policy.method: Reconstruct all favorable annual rows, preserve favorable Q4 cash-anchor delta, apply existing stress policies to those rows, recalculate taxes/cash/treasury, then reevaluate all cash flows at 10.625%. Do not subtract selected-case valuation deltas from favorable value.
policy.interpretation: Separate conditional cross-stresses, not a joint probability distribution, new central forecast or a confirmed lost customer. Packaging scale and Foundry cost stress are not combined with each other.

limits: Planning value is at December 31, 2026; the reference quote is November 5. The difference is not a contemporaneous margin of safety or guaranteed realized return.
The lower ERP methodology and favorable operating assumptions are a joint hypothesis, not established probabilities.
Missing customer-family stress is not news of a canceled contract. Cash-cost flexibility is not identified from public customer data.
Annual cash-floor checks do not establish intrayear liquidity under adverse receipt or spending timing.
